regime_read: The desk's convergence screenshot shows AI-power and semis signals piling up behind a handful of well-known names, with government-contract and patent channels recurring. The track record is empty, so conviction is capped low and the few names that are already extended must be watched, not chased.
regime_read_zh: 本台融合视图显示 AI 算力与半导体信号集中在少数几个知名标的上，政府合同与专利通道反复出现。战绩记录为空，因此置信度一律封顶为低；已经透支的名字只能观察，不能追。

theses.thesis: The pack shows congressional net buying (congress_net 6, 3 members), insider mspr at 100, 424 patents, and a bull stocktwits ratio [channels: congress_cluster, insider_mspr, patent_cluster, stocktwits_bull]. MU's rs_vs_spy_60d is -19.6, so the name is not extended and the entry is cleaner than others. However, earnings are 14 days out (2026-09-30) with a history of positive surprises (18.6%), which cuts both ways. The bull read is real but single-name specific rather than system-wide.
theses.thesis_zh: 证据包显示国会净买入（congress_net 6，3 名议员）、内部人 mspr 为 100、424 项专利、stocktwits 看多比 1.0 [通道：congress_cluster、insider_mspr、patent_cluster、stocktwits_bull]。MU 的 rs_vs_spy_60d 为 -19.6，并未透支，入场比其他大票干净。但财报只剩 14 天（2026-09-30），且历史上正惊喜率高（18.6%），两侧风险并存。看多逻辑成立，但更偏个股而非系统性。
second_order: AMAT — shared semis capex/patent theme and same congressional-cluster conviction if chip-equipment demand follows
SMCI — low put/call (0.29) and retail buzz flag leveraged AI-server demand downstream of memory
MU's HBM/DRAM suppliers and peers — memory pricing inflects the whole complex
theses.dissent: Earnings on 2026-09-30 are an event risk: one poor guide can unwind the congressional/insider alignment.

falsifier.text: Next earnings guide for the following quarter is below consensus or memory pricing turns down.

theses.thesis: The chip-equipment name shows congressional net buying (congress_net 4, 4 members, ~$47.4M position), a near-unanimous analyst cluster (bull ratio 0.97), 280 patents, and unusual options activity. rs_vs_spy_60d of -33.1 means the name has lagged badly and is not extended. This is a value-laggard-with-accretion-type setup, but the absence of insider or retail confirmation keeps conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: 这家设备股出现国会净买入（congress_net 4，4 名议员，约 $47.4M 持仓）、几乎一致的卖方上调簇（看多比 0.97）、280 项专利和异常期权活动。rs_vs_spy_60d 为 -33.1，说明其大幅跑输，并未透支。这是滞后的价值型吸筹形态，但缺少内部人或散户确认，置信度保持低位。
second_order: MU — memory capex drives equipment orders
NVDA — advanced packaging/tooling flows from AI chip demand
WFE peer complex — AMAT reads across to the group
theses.dissent: The put/call of 1.07 is not a bullish skew; the options flow is unusual but directionally ambiguous, and chip-equipment is late-cycle.

falsifier.text: Semiconductor equipment order data or AMAT's own bookings guidance turns down.

theses.thesis: NVDA has the broadest actor map: Jensen Huang controls [actor: Jensen Huang], Nancy Pelosi holds a stake [actor: Pelosi], MTG and Michael McCaul both hold [actor: Marjorie Taylor Greene, Michael McCaul], and Cramer talks about it [actor: Jim Cramer]. Meanwhile DPI z-score of 1.34, 241 patents, an analyst cluster at 1.0, and heavy retail buzz (207 WSB mentions) reinforce it. rs_vs_spy_60d of -0.6 is flat, so it is not extended. The catch: this is the most-crowded name in the market and a lot of the bullishness is already common knowledge.
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA 拥有最广的主体映射：Jensen Huang 控制 [actor:Jensen Huang]，Nancy Pelosi 持仓 [actor:Pelosi]，MTG 与 Michael McCaul 均持仓 [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene、Michael McCaul]，Cramer 频繁谈论 [actor:Jim Cramer]。同时 DPI z-score 1.34、241 项专利、卖方簇 1.0、散户热度极高（WSB 提及 207 次）。rs_vs_spy_60d 为 -0.6，并未透支。但这是全市场最拥挤的名字，多数利好多已人尽皆知。
second_order: AMAT/MU — chip tools and memory feeding NVDA platforms
AI power/DC infra names like HUT — direct energy bottleneck to NVDA-class compute
evidence: affiliation: multiple disclosed politician stakes [actor: Pelosi, Greene, McCaul]
theses.dissent: Crowding: when every politician, influencer, and retail desk is already involved, the marginal buyer pool is thinner and a small guidance miss hits hard.

falsifier.text: NVDA's next data-center revenue guide decelerates or a major customer delays orders.

theses.thesis: PLTR shows the strongest convergence score in the pack (7) with seven channels firing: gov_contract (≈$27.8M 30d), affiliation (MTG holds [actor: Marjorie Taylor Greene], Cathie Wood affiliates [actor: Cathie Wood]), analyst cluster at 1.0, github momentum, retail buzz, stocktwits bull at 1.0, and a trump-linked buy flag. But rs_vs_spy_60d of 32.9 is at the edge of the desk's extension threshold and the retail/StockTwits saturation is deep. This is a WATCH/AVOID: the data coheres, but the entry point is gone for now.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR 的融合评分是全包最高（7），七个通道同时触发：政府合同（30 日约 $27.8M）、关联（MTG 持仓 [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene]，Cathie Wood 联盟 [actor:Cathie Wood]）、卖方簇 1.0、github 动量、散户热度、stocktwits 看多 1.0，以及特朗普相关买方标记。但 rs_vs_spy_60d 为 32.9，已到透支阈值边缘，散户/StockTwits 饱和极深。数据一致，但入场点已经消失。
second_order: AI platform/defense-tech peers — PLTR's gov-cloud wins validate the vertical
MSFT — cloud/procurement partner overlap and similar gov-contract tailwind
Data-infra names indexed to federal modernization budgets
evidence: affiliation: MTG holds stake [actor: Marjorie Taylor Greene], Cathie Wood affiliates [actor: Cathie Wood]
theses.dissent: This is a crowded retail momentum name that has already run; entry now is effectively buying someone else's 30-point gain.

falsifier.text: Government-contract flow dries up for a quarter or a large insider/affiliate trims.

theses.thesis: A label mismatch flags the real theme behind 'American Bitcoin' (ABTC) as AI power/data-center infrastructure, with Hut 8 (HUT) as the parent controlling ~80% and operating the infrastructure [label_mismatch: ABTC→HUT, confidence 0.85]. The note points to a Dec-2025 Anthropic/Fluidstack 245MW $7B deal and a May-2026 $9.8B Beacon Point lease, with >$16.8B pipeline and 8.6GW in development. This is a clean re-theming read: the market labels it crypto, but the underlying economics are AI power. No price/extension data is given, so action is WATCH only.
theses.thesis_zh: 一个标签不匹配把 'American Bitcoin'（ABTC）背后的真实主题指向 AI 电力/数据中心基础设施，母公司 Hut 8（HUT）持有约 80% 并运营基础设施 [label_mismatch: ABTC→HUT，置信度 0.85]。注释指向 2025 年 12 月 Anthropic/Fluidstack 245MW $7B 合同、2026 年 5 月 $9.8B Beacon Point 租约，管线超 $16.8B、开发中 8.6GW。这是一个干净的重新主题化线索：市场标为加密，但底层经济是 AI 电力。缺少价格/透支数据，因此仅观察。
second_order: NVDA-class AI compute — its power demand directly benefits HUT's hosting/energy model
Data-center REITs/utilities — same AI power bottleneck
SMCI/AMAT — the hardware buildout implies server and tools demand
evidence: label_mismatch: entity American Bitcoin (ABTC), parent Hut 8 (HUT), confidence 0.85
note: Anthropic/Fluidstack 245MW $7B Dec-2025; $9.8B Beacon Point lease May-2026; >$16.8B pipeline; 8.6GW development
theses.dissent: The AI-power thesis is real but HUT's historical crypto balance sheet and the gap between announced pipeline and signed revenue make it binary.

falsifier.text: A major HUT power deal falls out of the pipeline without a replacement anchor tenant.
